variants.name: smooth crown lift, rounded shelf, jaw taper
variants.why: All three smooth, low-risk levers in one build, because the first plan's skull ellipsoids read lumpy (back oval and second skull faceted the occiput; silhouettes moved under .001 IoU) and a time budget allows only two variants. Crown_lift amp .04 sx .15 (amp*.86/sx .23, under the .3 ridge limit) for R01.3 (critic issue 3); cut blend .07 so the shelf underside and bulb-to-neck join round over for R01.4 (critic issue 2); head base half widths and chin pulled about half of the first plan's amounts for R01.5, which was never tried without the skulls. Edit at H25, the last R01 step.

variants.name: single smooth crown dome
variants.why: Method variant (skull ellipsoid raising the crown between the ear roots) done the way the first plan did not: ONE ellipsoid only, wide soft blend .09, centered forward of the occiput (y -.01 so it cannot push the rear crest into a bump), x radius .20 local (about .054 fig, the spec's crown half width), top about z .44; crown_lift removed. No back oval and no second skull, since the readers called those lumpy.
